summary: Turns every note it gets into a chord and passes the chord on, as a note insert before an instrument or on a note wire (it makes no sound itself). Chords: 20 shapes (triads, sevenths, ninths, sus, power, stacked fourths) or a Custom chord of up to four intervals, on any note (Fixed) or built in a key and scale from the scale degree played (Diatonic, triads or sevenths); inversion, spread (close, open, drop 2, wide), octave shift, an added bass note and a limit on the voices; velocity shaping; a strum (up, down, alternating, random) with its time, curve and a seeded humanize. Every voice ends when its note ends, and notes in the same pitch are counted so nothing sticks. Use it to play full chords from one key, to strum a pad or a guitar-like patch, and to keep a whole song in a key.
use_for: Turn single notes into chords before a synth: 20 chord shapes or a chord built in a key and scale, inversions and spreads, a bass note, velocity shaping and a strum with its own timing; sits before an instrument or on a note wire.

parameters.name: Chord
parameters.description: The chord built on each note played. Off passes the notes through unchanged
parameters.how: Chooses the chord shape put on every note you play: from Off (the note itself) through triads, sevenths and ninths to Custom.
parameters.sound: Major and Power are bright and open, Minor and Diminished darker; sevenths and ninths add jazz colour; stacked fourths sound modern and suspended.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Fixed puts the same shape on any note; Diatonic builds the chord from the scale degree played, in the Key and Scale below
parameters.how: Chooses between the same chord on every note (Fixed) and chords that follow a key and scale (Diatonic).
parameters.sound: Diatonic gives the right major, minor or diminished chord on each key of the scale, so every note you play stays in key.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: Diatonic: the key (the scale's first note)
parameters.how: Sets the first note of the scale the Diatonic chords are built in.
parameters.sound: It moves the whole set of chords up or down together; the played note picks which chord of the key sounds.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: Diatonic: the scale. A note that is not in the scale is taken as the scale note just below it
parameters.how: Chooses the scale the Diatonic chords are built in.
parameters.sound: Major is bright, natural minor dark; the modes sit in between (Dorian warm minor, Lydian dreamy major, Mixolydian bluesy major).

parameters.name: Diatonic chord
parameters.description: Diatonic: three-note chords (1-3-5 of the scale) or four-note chords (1-3-5-7)
parameters.how: Chooses triads or sevenths for the Diatonic chords.
parameters.sound: Triads are plain and strong; sevenths are richer and a little jazzy.

parameters.name: Custom 1
parameters.description: Custom chord, interval 1 in semitones above the root: -24 to +24, or Off. Used when Chord is Custom
parameters.how: Adds a note the first interval, in semitones from the played note (or none when Off) to the Custom chord.
parameters.sound: Stacks one more voice on the chord; negative values reach below the played note.

parameters.name: Custom 2
parameters.description: Custom chord, interval 2 in semitones above the root: -24 to +24, or Off. Used when Chord is Custom
parameters.how: Adds a note the second interval, in semitones from the played note (or none when Off) to the Custom chord.
parameters.sound: Stacks one more voice on the chord; negative values reach below the played note.

parameters.name: Custom 3
parameters.description: Custom chord, interval 3 in semitones above the root: -24 to +24, or Off. Used when Chord is Custom
parameters.how: Adds a note the third interval, in semitones from the played note (or none when Off) to the Custom chord.
parameters.sound: Stacks one more voice on the chord; negative values reach below the played note.

parameters.name: Custom 4
parameters.description: Custom chord, interval 4 in semitones above the root: -24 to +24, or Off. Used when Chord is Custom
parameters.how: Adds a note the fourth interval, in semitones from the played note (or none when Off) to the Custom chord.
parameters.sound: Stacks one more voice on the chord; negative values reach below the played note.

parameters.name: Inversion
parameters.description: Moves the lowest notes of the chord up an octave, one at a time (3 on a triad is the root position an octave up)
parameters.how: Sets how many of the lowest chord notes are moved up an octave, from 0 to 3.
parameters.sound: Inversions change which note is on the bottom, so the chord leans and moves smoothly from one to the next.

parameters.name: Spread
parameters.description: Close: as built. Open: every second note up an octave. Drop 2: the second note from the top down an octave. Wide: Open with the lowest note down an octave
parameters.how: Chooses how far the notes of the chord are spread: Close, Open, Drop 2 or Wide.
parameters.sound: Close is dense and organ-like; Open and Drop 2 are the airy voicings of a guitar or piano; Wide fills a pad's whole range.

parameters.name: Octave shift
parameters.description: Moves the whole chord up or down in octaves
parameters.how: Shifts every note of the chord by up to two octaves, down or up.
parameters.sound: It places the chord higher or lower without changing what it is.

parameters.name: Bass note
parameters.description: Adds the chord's root below the chord
parameters.how: Adds the root of the chord one or two octaves below it, or nothing.
parameters.sound: The added root gives the chord a floor, like a bass player's note under the chord.

parameters.name: Voices
parameters.description: The most notes the chord may have; the highest are dropped first (2 to 7)
parameters.how: Limits how many notes the chord has, from 2 to 7, dropping the highest first.
parameters.sound: Fewer voices thin out ninths and added basses to their lower notes.

parameters.name: Top voice
parameters.description: Velocity of the highest note of the chord, in percent of the played velocity
parameters.how: Scales the velocity of the top note of the chord from 0 to 200 %.
parameters.sound: More makes the top note ring out like a melody over the chord; less tucks it in.

parameters.name: Bass voice
parameters.description: Velocity of the lowest note of the chord (the added bass, or the chord's lowest note), in percent of the played velocity
parameters.how: Scales the velocity of the bottom note from 0 to 200 %.
parameters.sound: More gives a firm, weighty bottom; less lets the upper notes lead.

parameters.name: Velocity spread
parameters.description: A tilt across the chord from the lowest note to the highest: plus makes the top louder, minus the bottom
parameters.how: Tilts the velocities across the chord, from -100 % (the bottom loudest) to +100 % (the top loudest).
parameters.sound: Plus is bright and singing; minus is dark and weighty.

parameters.name: Strum
parameters.description: Plays the notes one after another instead of together: Up (lowest first), Down (highest first), Alternate (up on the first chord, then down, and so on for each new chord), Random
parameters.how: Chooses the order the chord's notes start in, or Off to play them together.
parameters.sound: Up and Down sound like a hand sweeping across strings; Alternate swaps between them every chord; Random is a loose, rolling arpeggio.

parameters.name: Strum time
parameters.description: The time from the first to the last note of the chord
parameters.how: Sets how long the strum takes from its first to its last note, from 0 to 250 ms.
parameters.sound: Short times are a quick flick of the fingers; long times are a slow, harp-like roll.

parameters.name: Strum curve
parameters.description: Plus: the notes come faster and faster; minus: slower and slower (0 is even)
parameters.how: Bends the spacing of the strummed notes from slowing (-100 %) to accelerating (+100 %).
parameters.sound: Accelerating strums rush to the top like a fast sweep; slowing ones start quickly and let the last notes trail.

parameters.name: Humanize time
parameters.description: Each note is late by a random time up to this
parameters.how: Delays each note by a random time up to 30 ms, from the seed's random stream.
parameters.sound: It loosens a block chord into a played one; it is a few milliseconds of looseness, not a strum.

parameters.name: Humanize velocity
parameters.description: Each note's velocity changes by a random amount up to this percentage
parameters.how: Varies each note's velocity at random by up to 30 %.
parameters.sound: It makes the chord uneven in the way a hand is.

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.description: The seed of the random stream (Random strum, Humanize): the same seed gives the same notes every time
parameters.how: Chooses which random sequence the Random strum and the Humanize controls follow.
parameters.sound: Different seeds give different loosenesses; the same seed always repeats exactly.
